Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.client

Class LocalPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.client.ClientPlayer
it.polimi.ingsw.model.client.LocalPlayer
public class LocalPlayer extends ClientPlayer
Represents the player associated to the local machine. It saves the player's hand cards and his personal objectives.
